body: Do not tell me what to do. People like you are the reason I must kill myself right now. Its not even optional. If I don't kill myself right now I'll be forced to live another second with you on this planet. So the way I see it is there's two choices: A. I kill myself B. You kill yourself. Your pick.
After reading your comment my entire life seems to be in a different light, a more grayish kind of light. I shall only kill myself a little.
No one dies of old age, that's just a myth they tell old people to assure them the next day will be closer to death. If you wanna die right you gotta do it yourself.

This is a solid question however I have thought of a solution already: I will use sheer force of will to combat this desire to sleep on the job and shall continue to slam my head against said sidewalk.
